title: Split validator validation and retained coverage into focused private modules
description: Split validator validation and retained coverage into focused private modules
acceptance_criteria: Organize validator implementation and existing unit tests into cohesive private modules with the facade and every new source or test file below 1000 lines where a coherent boundary permits; preserve public and crate-visible API paths, validation ordering, severity, diagnostic text, coverage JSON and metrics, retained capabilities, identity and race checks, deterministic traversal and shared budgets; retain all existing tests and platform guards; synchronize canonical spec coverage and verify behavior against the unchanged baseline without weakening security or lifecycle gates

answers.constraints: Preserve specs/validator/context.md retained-root authority, shared deterministic budgets and selected identities, bounded live handles, snapshot-only validation, ordered diagnostic severity, and explicit-source manifest failures as carried notices. No configured principles file exists. Preserve every existing public behavior and platform guard.
